text: I checked the signin proposal and it's clear, with nothing to rewrite. `node Server/text-check.mjs` printed no flags. `requirements.md` is a brief for agents and there's no owner-facing report or page, so I didn't take screenshots. I logged one `clear` line to `flags.jsonl`.

`kit/requirements.md` fails the "Short" and "Shown, not told" checks. I sent the rewrite to `mastermind-forms`, which owns it and is running.

- **Too long:** it runs 611 words. The opening paragraph is about 120 words, and the Stage 1 "Check it" bullet is about 100.
- **Structure told, not shown:** the `ux/Form/` file layout is described in sentences instead of a tree.
- **Text check:** `text-check.mjs` came back clean (`[]`).
- **Sent to the owner:** a link-list opener, a file tree for `ux/Form/`, a ticked checklist for the "Check it" step, and a 60-word cap on every other bullet.

I logged one `sent` line to `flags.jsonl`.

I wrote both files, `findings.md` and `proposal.md`, in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/auth/`, and added a log line to `session.jsonl` there. I didn't run any code or tests.

The clarity message arrived after I'd written them. It says no rewrite was needed, so there is nothing to change on my side.

- **What exists:** the Worker already has a user system with Google sign-in, but real Google sign-in has never run. `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is empty on every stage, and nothing stores form answers.
- **Proposal:** build on the existing Worker rather than adding a second auth system. Add an answers table to the per-user Durable Object (`worker/settings.js`), plus `GET` and `PUT /api/answers` routes that read the user from the cookie.

I found no audit named "users" or "auth" in `ai/audits`. The closest are the `platform/research` verdicts for users and security. The 2026-11-13 `mastermind-user-auth` task was stopped and left no report.

The brief and `past-work.md` were in the main tree (`C:\Code\lew42\monorepo`), not my worktree, so I wrote the two files there. I created no accounts, keys or resources and changed no code.

Files are in public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/auth/:
- findings.md
- proposal.md

Landed `landed` in my task log (`db047064c1` on `worktree/forms-signin`, not merged). The sign-in page is at http://forms-signin.localhost/framework/ux/Auth/google/.

- **Page:** Level 1 is the portrait talking-head video. It is a real `<video>` with `V01.jpg` as the poster, a soft bottom scrim, the host's one line and one dark "Sign in with Google" button. Beside it (a third column at 3440) are the light and dark button variants in all three wordings, and the sign-in view. That view offers Google, Apple and an email link, with "Use a password instead" one tap down. On a phone it stacks; on desktop the video stays centred and not stretched.
- **New files in `ux/Auth/`:** `GoogleButton.js`, `SignIn.js`, `VideoSignIn.js`, `google/page.js` with the two stills, and `GoogleButton.test.mjs`. The test passes in 0.05 s.
- **Mock vs real:** `client_id: ""` forces the mock. If you leave it out, the button asks `/api/config` like `/app/` does. A real id makes Google's own SDK draw the button and post the token to `/api/auth/google`. The mock fires `signin` with a fake user and says so on screen.
- **Docs:** I updated `ux/Auth/readme.md` and the `files` and `children` lists in `ux/Auth/page.js`.
- **Checks:** I read screenshots at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440. `node Server/smoke.mjs` shows no FAIL, only the existing 404 warnings for `ai/*.json`.
- **Not done:**
  - I never opened the Figma overlay page (`103:11`), so the overlay is not checked against it.
  - The real Google path has never run, because `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is empty.
  - Apple is a mock.
